QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Taken by Kamuna's Will
QuestInfo.0: You protected the pilot -- barely -- but something doesn't add up. What's an army of assassin bots doing in peacetime, and how did they know to come after this particular kid? Go see what #p9401533# has to say about it.
QuestInfo.1: In Akihabara, Tokyo, the stranded soldiers and civilians have built a resistance base. From there, they're coordinating with the ZDF soldiers to launch a coordinated attack with the ultimate weapon. But in another 'correction' to the timeline, the machines have learned the base's location early, and they're heading to attack it now. Time warp to Akihabara in 2102, and defend the command center.
